title: Tamsin and the Will
author: Jonah Crane
blurb: Coral Halloran, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
